title: The Sacred Water Odyssey
name: 15-Day South Kerala New Year Ceremony & Renewal Journey
description: Welcome the New Year in magical Kerala, a land of lush greenery and serene waterways. This journey is a ritual of cleansing and renewal, woven around sacred ceremonies, Ayurvedic rejuvenation, and practices that restore inner balance.
shortDescription: Transformational 15-day New Year Kerala journey with sacred waterfalls, backwater cruises, spice plantation walks & comprehensive Ayurvedic healing.
highlights: New Year's Eve Fire Ceremony – Ring in the year with ritual by Kerala's grandest falls.
Private Houseboat Cruise – Glide past backwaters and palm-lined villages in Kumarakom.
Morning Safari in Periyar – Spot elephants and rare birds in Kerala's misty hills.
Ayurvedic Ocean Retreat – Three days of healing therapies and oceanfront serenity.
Tribal Village Experience – Share meals and traditions with Kerala's hill tribes.
Spice Trails of Fort Kochi – Explore spice markets and storied colonial streets.

title: The Living Traditions Trail
name: 15-Day North Kerala Tribal & Cultural Immersion Journey
description: Immerse yourself in the heart of North Kerala, where the rhythm of villages and temples guides you into a world rich with wisdom and hospitality. This journey celebrates culture, flavors, and the spiritual heritage of this extraordinary region.
shortDescription: 15-day mystical North Kerala journey with authentic Theyyam rituals, tribal culture immersion, beach yoga & traditional Ayurvedic treatments.
highlights: Theyyam Temple Ceremonies – Witness ancient rituals unchanged for centuries.
Tribal Community Immersion – Meet Kurichya and Kurumba elders in hill villages.
Bamboo Raft Meditation – Float silently through pristine Wayanad forests.
UNESCO Vadakkunnathan Temple – Private tours with temple priests and scholars.
Kerala Mural Workshops – Learn traditional techniques with natural pigments.
Coastal Ayurvedic Retreat – Personalized healing programs by the Arabian Sea.

title: The Spirit of Karnataka
name: 15-Day Karnataka Royal Heritage & Wellness Journey
description: Discover the majestic spirit of Karnataka—a land of palaces, art, and serenity. Begin your days with yoga in Mysore, explore wildlife on a Kabini safari, breathe in the aromas of Coorg's hills, and reflect in ancient Jain temples that echo timeless traditions.
shortDescription: 15-day transformational South India journey through Karnataka with daily yoga, Ayurvedic therapies, heritage locations & cultural immersion.
highlights: Mysore Yoga Sessions – Daily practice with spiritual guidance and meditation.
Private Mysore Palace Tours – Explore royal halls with heritage experts.
Udupi Ayurvedic Healing – Authentic coastal retreat with traditional therapies.
Nagarhole Wildlife Safari – Spot elephants and leopards in Kabini forests.
Jain Heritage in Karkala – Discover ancient temples and peaceful traditions.
Local Family Experiences – Share meals and stories with Karnataka families.
